# The DTG Research KB

The **Decentralized Trust Graph ZKP research corpus** — the decision baseline, nineteen explorations, the lab evidence layer (16 suites · 162 properties), and the chronicles — projected here from its source of truth.

**Source of truth (G0):** the research root `~/dtgwg-cred-spec-main_mage` + the TF workbench lab. This wiki is a projection that carries lineage; it is rebuilt by `node tools/build-kb.mjs`, never hand-edited. The vendored upstream Credentials Core Spec is deliberately NOT projected (others' work — read it at trustoverip.github.io/dtgwg-cred-spec).

# Start here

- [[Decision — Overview]] — the Predicate & Assurance-Boundary Decision Document (v0.1.0-draft), split per section
- [[Explorations Index]] — the exploration corpus (O-series + X-series, all built)
- [[Briefing 2026-07-18 — ZKP Explorations]] — the TF briefing draft
- [[Workflow — Workbench and Research Root]] — the workbench/research-root loop
- [[Lab — Runtimes]] — the lab evidence layer (16 suites · 162 properties)

# Attribution and gates

Decision document + explorations: Mitch (Soulbis), co-chair, DTG ZKP Task Force (ToIP/LFDT); working drafts, not ratified specification. Lab code: local reference models and lab-only circuits (the trusted setup is explicitly not a production ceremony). Everything here passed the build's manifest-first classification and secrets gate.

## 🤝 The Trust Tasks

agentprivacy's proposed contributions to the ToIP trust-task registry — agent-admission and understanding families, ten specs + two design notes: [[The Trust Tasks]].
